posts.cooked:
boxerboyhomer:

Are the Quick Reference Sheets and Deck Search Sheets going to get updated with the new characters?

Everything will get updated.  The update should include:

  • Randomizer (done, although I may go back and spruce up some of the pix)
  • FAQ (done, though I'll continue adding stuff as we get new rulings)
  • Card List (done)
  • Vengeance accessories
  • Deck Search Sheets (adding a page for Sentinels and Naturalist)
  • Quick Reference Sheet
  • Greatest Legacy and G.I. Bunker oversized cards
The Vengeance accessories will have:
  • boxes for no-sleeves and penny-sleeved cards for all new enviros, heroes, and each of the V5 villains
  • oversized hero trackers, with a single tracker for the Sentinels which has four integrated hp spinners on it.
  • oversized villain cards. Each of the V5 has a mini-villain-sized card like the members of the Ennead have.
  • oversized mats for the two new environments
  • card-sized hp trackers for each new character.  The Sentinels each get their own, as do each of the V5 villains and each of the other heroes.
Setback's oversized hero tracker is a normal one for now, but I really want to make a version that has an additional smaller tracker wheel to track his Unlucky pool.  If that interests you, you may want to hold off printing out the Setback tracker that will be included with the update until I can put that together.

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked: The Randomizer now has links you can click to check/uncheck all of the items in a set.  I debated whether or not to have a single link toggle all of the heroes/villains/enviros in an entire expansion at once, but decided against it because in general, it's not a good idea to have a button manipulate things off screen (when the user scrolls down and sees that things have changed, they may or may not associate the change with the action they took farther up the page).  So for now, if you want to toggle everything for a set, you'll do it independently for the heroes, villains, and enviros.  If that turns out to be a gigantic pain, let me know and I'll revisit my decision.
